note: Caption looks (R-4.1): <grouping>-<presentation>, our own words. Pixel values are at a 1080 px wide frame and scale with the width. Every number marked starting is a starting value, measured on real reels before it is called final.

word.desc: one word per caption, timed to the word (fast, energetic content)

phrase.desc: 2-4 words, never across a pause or a sentence end

line.desc: one readable line up to the safe width, split at clause boundaries

glue.note: on top of the motion_layout.glue units: a number and its unit are never split

clean.desc: text with a soft brand-tinted drop plate, no outline stroke

scrim.note: only when white fails on the footage itself: a soft-edged ink scrim behind the line (judged as covering the text at `coverage` of its opacity), stepped until white reaches target_contrast (moving footage: past the large-text minimum) or max_opacity; the glyph-shaped drop plate alone is never counted for contrast

boxed.desc: text on a squared plate in brand ink with an accent foot along its bottom edge

highlight.desc: the word being spoken gets the system's foot rule in the brand highlight colour, sliding word to word under the line's lowest ink (never through Arabic joining strokes or descenders); the text keeps the clean look's soft drop plate; stacking: plate (and scrim), then the foot, then the text

scrim.note: only when white fails on the footage itself: a soft-edged ink scrim behind the line (judged as covering the text at `coverage` of its opacity), stepped until white reaches target_contrast (moving footage: past the large-text minimum) or max_opacity; the glyph-shaped drop plate alone is never counted for contrast

underlay.colour: the client's T4.2 highlight_colour (the compiled spec's style.highlight.hex) when set, else the brand highlight; it must show against what is behind it (scrim included) at min_contrast, else the next brand colour (highlight, accent, primary), else a note
underlay.geometry: one y per line: the lower of the line's lowest ink and the font's descender line, + gap_em; height_px thick (the boxed foot's 8 px); each word's ink bounds + pad_em, square ends (R2 round 5, designer's pick)
underlay.note: the band keeps the brand highlight colour on every frame (it is laid over the plate): on a bright frame the scrim gets stronger instead

colour.desc: the emphasised word takes the brand highlight colour (contrast-checked)

on_band.why: a coloured word would sit on the moving highlight band

weight.desc: the emphasised word is 200 weight units heavier in the same family (never italic)

tag.desc: the emphasised word sits on a squared accent tag whose bottom edge sits on the caption's bottom line (the plate's foot, or the line's bottom)
tag.foot_note: clean and highlight looks: a highlight rule flush with the tag's bottom edge anchors it like the boxed foot (R2 review); boxed tags merge into the plate's foot instead

word-highlight.why: a one-word caption has nothing to move the highlight between

auto.basis: starting values (R-4.1 §5), measured against editor picks on real reels
